full_prompt_en: A square close-up animated image shows a young archer from the chest upward in a blue, softly blurred forest. Straight dark-blue hair falls to the chin, with one long lock crossing the forehead and partly covering the right eye. The head tips back slightly as large warm-brown eyes look upward toward something outside the frame. A small rounded nose and closed mouth give the face a determined, uncertain expression. The figure wears a textured red scarf and dark blue clothing. A worn silver shoulder guard made of overlapping plates catches cool light on the right side of the image, while a darker rough guard sits on the left. Two crossing straps run over the chest, and a bundle of arrows rises behind the left shoulder. The background remains out of focus, with vertical blue trunks or forms and scattered soft red-orange patches. A small warm orb glows near the top edge, echoing the eye color and scarf against the dominant blue. The face has rounded, carefully modeled volume and a tactile, handcrafted look, with visible texture in the scarf, straps and armor. Cool light from the front and above brightens the cheeks and metal, while deeper blue shadow sits under the chin and hair. The tight composition concentrates on the upward gaze, with the arrow shafts and shoulder plates supplying diagonal and stepped accents. The overall scene combines intimate character emotion with a mysterious, cool woodland atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画特写呈现一名年轻弓手胸部以上的形象，身后是蓝色、柔化的树林。笔直的深蓝头发落到下巴，一绺长发越过额头，部分遮住右眼。头略向后仰，暖棕色大眼望向画面之外的上方。小而圆的鼻子和闭合的嘴让神情兼具坚定与不安。人物围着有肌理的红围巾，穿深蓝衣服。图像右侧的磨旧银色肩甲由重叠片板组成，接住冷光，左肩则有较暗、粗糙的护片。两道带子在胸前交叉，一束箭从左肩后升起。背景保持失焦，竖向蓝色树干或形体之间散布柔软红橙色斑块。上缘附近一点暖光与眼色、围巾呼应，对着主导的蓝色。面孔体积圆润、塑造细致，并有可触的手工感，围巾、背带和护甲保留可见材质。前上方冷光照亮双颊和金属，下巴和发丝下则聚着更深蓝影。紧凑构图集中于仰望的目光，箭杆和肩甲片提供斜线与阶梯状强调。整体场景把亲近的人物情绪与神秘冷色林间空气结合。
style_prompt_en: The image has a tactile animated-film surface with rounded modeled volumes, selective material texture and gentle depth of field. Deep blue and cyan dominate the field, crossed by concentrated red-orange accents and cool metallic highlights. Nearby smooth forms retain precise features, while distant vertical marks soften into atmospheric blur. Light is cool and directional across the near surface, with small warm points adding contrast and blue shadow collecting beneath overlaps. Edges are clear at the focal center and gradually dissolve toward the background. Layered bands, straps and plated textures introduce stepped and diagonal rhythms against a largely vertical soft field. The composition is close and emotionally focused, with a slight upward tilt that opens space above the focal form. Surfaces feel crafted rather than glossy, and their subtle wear keeps the image grounded. The overall effect is cinematic and intimate, balancing expressive simplicity, material detail and a mysterious color atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有可触的动画电影表面，圆润塑形、选择性材质肌理和柔和景深并存。深蓝与青色主导色域，集中红橙强调和冷金属亮点穿过其中。近处平滑形体保留准确特征，远处竖向笔痕则柔化为有空气感的失焦。冷光有方向地越过近表面，少量暖光点形成对照，蓝影聚在遮挡处下方。边缘在焦点中央清楚，向背景逐渐溶解。层叠色带、交叉斜线和片状肌理在大体竖向的柔色域前建立阶梯与斜向节奏。构图贴近且聚焦情绪，轻微向上的倾斜在焦点上方打开空间。表面有手工制作感而不光滑炫目，细小磨损让图像落地。整体效果电影感且亲近，以表现力的简洁、材质细节和神秘的色彩空气相平衡。
theme_en: A blue-haired animated young archer looks upward in a cool forest, wearing a red scarf and worn shoulder armor
theme_zh: 一名蓝发动画少年弓手在冷色树林里仰望，穿红围巾和磨旧肩甲
name: Kubo And The Two Strings
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
